faq_a1: It's a process that calibrates the software of the vehicle's control unit(s) to adapt the electronics to its specific characteristics, updating and optimising its performance to provide a better user experience.
faq_q2: Will I lose my vehicle's official warranty?
faq_a2: No, the process is carried out safely through SCN coding, without tampering with any vehicle part and without altering the original software of any control unit. As a safety measure, the configuration is always backed up before and after the changes.
faq_q3: How long does a service take?
faq_a3: Usually between 30 minutes and 2 hours, depending on the number of services agreed and their difficulty.
faq_q4: I'm interested in your services, where can I find you?
faq_a4: We don't have a workshop, but we work directly on your vehicle in Almería city at no travel cost. We also carry out work outside the city or province, but with an additional travel surcharge.
faq_q5: I'm not from Almería but I'm interested in one of your services, what can I do?
faq_a5: If you have the necessary hardware and need help, we can assist you remotely. We have extensive experience in retrofits and coding. Remote assistance requires a stable internet connection where the coding work will be carried out and software such as TeamViewer or AnyDesk. If you don't have the vehicle coding software, we'll provide it.
faq_q6: Do SCN Coding jobs come with a warranty?
faq_a6: Yes, we offer a 1-year warranty for any coding or retrofit job.
